title: Using Dynamics
coreMove: Read the motion in the situation before choosing when and how to move.
sourcePressure: Movement over time creates openings and traps that static position misses; sequence, reaction, timing, and changing options matter strategically. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Dynamics means moving fast or responding to change in general.
